key_idea: Pick the lowest digit d (same parity as N, d<=t) and recurse on (N-d)/2; only values floor(N/2^k)-c with small c are ever reached.
sketch: Memoized recursion f(n)=sum over d in [0,t], d==n mod 2, d<=n of f((n-d)/2), f(0)=1, modulo 998244353. Reachable arguments at depth k lie within about t of N/2^k, so there are O(t log N) states with O(t) transitions each, roughly 54*100*50 operations. A hash map keyed by the 64-bit value is enough. Leading zeros are automatically excluded because the recursion stops at 0; N=0 is answered as 1 (the single representation 0).
